answer_1.quote: In the first part of this work, we construct cross-lingual instances by aligning English instances with their translations into morphologically rich languages, so as to probe the robustness of CoR in current NMT models... In the second part of our work, we empirically put these assumptions to the test with multilingual schema instances... for MLLMs.

answer_2.quote: Accuracy is based on the number of instances in which the correct translation is assigned the lower perplexity score. BLEU scores were computed with SacreBLEU. For MLLMs, we compute sentence-level pseudo-perplexities (PPPL) for two completions.

answer_4.quote: we recruited two bilingual raters for each language pair and asked them to select correct translations for a randomly drawn subset of 100 MT-Wino-X samples.
